voicePage.title: Join a voice room
voicePage.hint: Enter the same name on two devices, logged in with two different Nostr keys, to start a call. Audio, video and screen sharing go peer to peer over WebRTC; only the signaling goes through the relay.

landing.inCall: {count, plural, one {# person is in this call.} other {# people are in this call.}}
landing.empty: No one is detected in this call yet.

roster.syncingCount: {count, plural, one {# participant detected; roster names are still syncing.} other {# participants detected; roster names are still syncing.}}

starting.label: SFU connecting
starting.detail: Asking the SFU to open this big-room call.

connected.label: SFU connected
connected.detail: Big-room mode active: media is routed through the SFU.

unavailable.label: SFU unavailable
unavailable.detail: No big-room SFU is advertising. Falling back to peer-to-peer mesh (max 4 participants).

unauthorized.label: SFU rejected
unauthorized.detail: Big-room start was rejected. Your account may not be whitelisted on the SFU’s trusted relay. Call is on peer-to-peer mesh (max 4 participants).

meshSyncDetail: {count, plural, one {Peer detected; WebRTC media channels are still syncing in the background.} other {# peers detected; WebRTC media channels are still syncing in the background.}}
